SELECT sp.specNumber,r.node_id resolution_node,r.resolutionId,r.content,
      cr.node_id cr_node,cr.tdocNumber,cr.type,mo.edge_id modifies_edge,rr.edge_id reference_edge,
      wt.edge_id related_edge FROM CR cr
      JOIN rel_RELATED_TO wt ON wt.src_id=cr.node_id
      JOIN WorkItem w ON w.node_id=wt.dst_id
      JOIN rel_MODIFIES mo ON mo.src_id=cr.node_id
      JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=mo.dst_id
      JOIN rel_REFERENCES rr ON rr.dst_id=cr.node_id
      JOIN Resolution r ON r.node_id=rr.src_id
      WHERE w.workItemCode='NR_newRAT-Perf'
